# ws180g005_fd_pr: primitives of the wafer.space 180 nm generic PDK

`ws180g005_fd_pr` is the primitive device library of the `ws180g005` variant (5 V only) of
ws180g, the wafer.space 180 nm generic PDK. In the name, `ws180g005` is the process variant,
`fd` says the library comes from this project and `pr` is the library type, primitives.

**Status: Phase 0 placeholder.** This repository holds no library content yet.

## The content is generated by the build

This is an output repository. Its content is generated by the build of the meta-repository,
<https://github.com/wafer-space-robot/ws180g-pdk>, one file per item, and committed by that
build. It must not be edited by hand: a change made here is lost at the next build. To
change something, change the process description or the generators in the meta-repository,
where the design document and the tests for the whole PDK also live.

The meta-repository carries this repository as the submodule `libraries/ws180g005_fd_pr`.
A library introduced in one variant is shared, unchanged, by every larger variant, so there
is no per-variant copy of it.
